As Cook, WG-7404, your typical work assignments may include, but not limited to: Perform a wide variety of food processing and cooking tasks to prepare regular and special diet entrees. Ensure the proper procedures are used in the storage and handling of food.

Plan meal preparations and processes to ensure food is done on time and at the right temperature. Instruct the Food Service Worker in the receipt, check, or issuance of subsistence and on subsistence items, as well as the proper handling and storage of food. Maintain inventory and operation of food service appliances and equipment.
EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS: (OPM Operating Manual, Qualification Standards - WG-7400 Food Preparation And Serving Family) Applicants must meet the qualification requirements contained in the OPM Standards. For this position, they are listed below.

The applicant must meet the requirements of the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Handbook X118C, Job Qualification System for Trades and Labor Occupations. The applicant must have sufficient training and experience to be trusted to perform duties on their own initiative under general supervision.

While no specific amount of experience is required, you must show that you possess the knowledge, skills and abilities to perform the duties of the position. The approved job elements for this occupation are: 1. Ability to perform the duties of a Cook without more than normal supervision 2. Ability to use tools and maintain equipment 3.

Work practices 4. Technical Practices 5. Knowledge of materials 6. Ability to interpret instructions 7. Dexterity and Safety Physical Demands Work requires continual standing and walking, and frequent stooping, reaching, pushing and pulling, and bending.

Frequently lifts or moves objects weighing up to 50 pounds unassisted and occasionally lifts or moves objects weighing over 50 pounds with the assistance of lifting devices with other workers. Working Conditions The work is performed in kitchen areas which are well lit but are often hot and noisy.

The incumbent is exposed to steam, fumes, and odors from cooking and to extreme temperature changes when entering walk-in refrigeration or freezing units. There is danger of slipping on wet floors that have been recently mopped or where food has been spilled.

Subject to possible cuts from knives and burns from steam, hot foods, stoves and hot grease and water. The working environment is inside a detention/correctional facility where safety, health, and security practices are adhered to for the safety of staff and inmates.

All qualification requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement. Additional selections may be made from this announcement if identical vacancies occur in the same location within 90 days from the closing date.

Performs a full range of simple cooking by preparing and cooking items that require little or no processing, such as pancakes, sausage, eggs, hamburgers, and fresh or canned vegetables.
Prepares hot cereals and concentrated or dehydrated soups, sauces and gravies.
Prepares food by peeling, chopping, grinding, paring, cutting, slicing, dicing, pureeing, dredging, flouring, or breading. Weighs, measures, and assembles ingredients for regular and modified menu items.
Uses and cleans a variety of cooking utensils to measure, weigh, and process food items. Cleans, stores, and maintains all equipment and work areas after each use.
Operates a variety of kitchen equipment using gas, electricity, steam, or microwave heat sources. Disassembles, cleans, assembles component parts and accessories, following safety procedures to avoid personal injury and damage to equipment.

Resumes must be two pages (or less). Resumes should clearly demonstrate the applicant's relevant experience, skills, knowledge and abilities as they pertain to this position. A qualified candidate must possess the following: Work experience in preparing foods and cooking simple foods and short orders in a cafeteria, restaurant, or mess.

Demonstration of the following work behavior is desirable: a. Neatness and good grooming. b. Dependability. c. Ability to work under pressure This experience must be reflected on your resume to be considered eligible for this position.

Your qualifications will be evaluated on the following competencies: Basic knowledge of food preparation methods and procedures. Skill to cook a limited variety of prepared foods or short order foods. Ability to read and understand written food service material, such as food labels, standardized recipes, and basic work instructions.

Skill in performing basic mathematical computations to multiply ingredients in a recipe or to determine how many servings a container will hold. Knowledge of the various tables of weights and measures and ability to follow instructions to convert from standard to metric measurements.

Skill in operating, disassembling and cleaning basic food service equipment such as griddles, broilers, and food grinders. Knowledge of basic sanitation, infection and spoilage control procedures.

Performs a full range of simple cooking tasks by preparing and cooking items that require little or no processing such as pancakes, sausage, eggs, hamburgers, and fresh or canned vegetables. Prepares hot cereals, broiled meats; prepares and cooks concentrated or dehydrated soups, sauces and gravies; makes cold sandwich fillings.

Prepares convenience items such as frozen hash browns, fish fillets and chicken nuggets. Some cooks at this level prepare and bake pizza.

Prepares food by peeling, chopping, grinding, paring, cutting, slicing, dicing, pureeing, dredging, flouring, or breading; weighs, measures, assembles ingredients for regular menu items; sets up and replenishes salad bar; portions foods for distribution and meal service, and covers, dates, and stores leftovers according to established procedures.

Washes and cleans kitchen equipment. Skills and Knowledge of the methods and procedures relating to food presentation. Ability to follow oral and written instructions, work safely, and do simple arithmetic.

Knowledge of operating and cleaning food service equipment, characteristics of various foods, and the ability to season foods according to set procedures. Physical effort includes continual standing and walking, and frequent stooping, reaching, pulling, pushing and bending.

Frequently lifts or moves objects weighing up to 40 pounds unassisted and occasionally lifts or moves objects over 40 pounds with assistance. Working conditions include working in hot and noisy kitchen. Exposure to steam, fumes, and odors. Danger of falling, burns and cuts.

Exposure to extreme temperatures when entering walk-in refrigerators or freezer units. May operate one or more motor vehicles to include light trucks, sedans, utility vehicles and golf carts on the installation. Performs other duties as assigned.

You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if the position allows for qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application.

Qualifying Experience: Must have experience in and knowledge of methods and procedures relating to food preparation and presentation gained in a grill, snack bar, restaurant, club or similar food activity. Ability to follow oral and written instructions, work safely, and do simple arithmetic.

Knowledge of operating and cleaning food service equipment, characteristics of various foods, and the ability to season food and decide when foods are done is required. Must be physically able to frequently lift objects weighing up to 40 pounds. Must be able to continuously stand, walk, stoop, reach, push, pull and bend for long periods of time.

Must be able to obtain a Food handler's Certificate. Subject to satisfactory completion of pre-employment physical and National Agency Check. Must meet appropriate minimum age requirement for serving alcoholic beverages. Must possess a valid state driver's license appropriate to the size and type of vehicle operated.

You will be evaluated on the basis of your level of competency in the following areas:

Boils, bakes, fries, and broils meats, fish, and poultry by watching the item cooking; turning as required, regulating temperature, and removing when done. Adjusts standardized recipes for large quantity cooking. Maintains proper temperature for all food during holding, transport, reheating, and serving to ensure food safety.

Washes and cleans kitchen equipment. Assists in training guidelines on new policy and procedures. Responsible for meal preparation/serving of all meals and snacks in specified quantities to meet Air Force requirements related to Air Force Childcare Food Programs.

Prepares an Air Force Form 287 for the Director's review and approval for purchasing food. Purchases supplies weekly. Assists in preparing USDA forms CCFP-6 and food counts. Submits reports to the CDC Director for review. Attends all training sessions and staff meetings as required. Responsible for general food sanitation of the kitchen.

Maintains cleanliness throughout the kitchen/dining room areas during scheduled hours of duty. Follows posted menu. Informs Child Development Center Director of any necessary menu changes for recording. Provides food for other staff members for field trips and cooking experiences for the children in the center.

Uses Air Force-approved seasonal cycle menus and rotates on the approved schedule. Provides nutritionally equivalent substitutions for children with food allergies/sensitivities. Performs other related duties as assigned.

You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if the position allows for qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application. Qualifying Experience:Must have adequate experience in preparing and serving nutritional foods for young children.

Must have basic knowledge of food preparation principles and practical understanding of physical changes that occur during the processing and cooking of food. Must have ability to follow instructions, work safely, and do simple arithmetic. Must be able to follow USDA requirements.

Must be willing to go through training required by the service regulation. Knowledge of operating and cleaning food service equipment and the ability to season food and decide when foods are done is required.

Must have practical knowledge of methods and procedures necessary for ordering, issuing, and storing food items in accordance with inventory and sanitation requirements. Must be 18 years of age, hold a high school diploma or equivalent, have the ability to speak, read and write English.

Must be physically able to frequently lift objects weighing up to 40 pounds with assistance. Must be able to obtain Food Handler's card and satisfactorily complete all pre-employment and investigative requirements.

Leader of 3 or more employees, providing technical guidance and oversight to lower-graded personnel to ensure proper food preparation and adherence to standardized recipes.
Prepares and bakes a wide variety of food items. Plans, coordinates, and times multiple food preparation steps to ensure menu items are ready for service at the same time and with minimal waste.
Inspects food items for freshness and quality before preparation and evaluates finished products to ensure established standards are met.
Modifies recipes and adjusts ingredient quantities, servings, seasonings, and preparation methods based on production needs and available equipment.
Maintains sanitation, food safety, and cleanliness standards in work areas, utensils, equipment, and food service operations. Performs other duties assigned.
Resumes must be two pages (or less). Resumes should clearly demonstrate the applicant's relevant experience, skills, knowledge and abilities as they pertain to this position.

A qualified candidate must possess the following Work experience or education directly related to the duties to be performed Expert knowledge of quantity food preparation and baking procedures, including complex and standardized recipes for daily meals and catered events.

Ability to independently prepare a wide range of meats, vegetables, sauces, gravies, and baked goods at varying levels of difficulty.

Skill in planning, coordinating, and timing multiple food preparation steps to ensure all menu items are ready for service simultaneously with minimal waste Ability to inspect food for freshness and quality, evaluate finished products, and make substitutions, seasoning changes, or corrective actions to maintain standards Ability to modify recipes for serving size, ingredient quantities, and available equipment, including large-quantity production requirements Skill in providing technical guidance and oversight to lower-graded personnel, while maintaining sanitation, safety, cleanliness, and food service operational standards In addition to the above qualifications, candidates who possess the following qualifications will be considered "Highly Preferred" or "Best Qualified": Food and/ beverage inventory experience Experience utilizing and preparing meals from standardized recipes Knowledge and experience applying established Food Safety and Sanitation Standards (ie.

HACCP, ServSafe, Public Health Codes)

Must have experience in and knowledge of food preparation principles and characteristics of food, and of planning processes to ensure entire meals are prepared and cooked on time. Must be able to preform yield testing to determine portion cost and to adjust ingredients in standardized recipes.

Must have knowledge of procedures to order, issue and store food. Experience and knowledge must have been gained in a grill, snack bar, restaurant, club or similar food activity. Must be physically able to frequently lift objects weighing up to 40 pounds, and occasionally over 40 pounds.

Must be able to continuously stand, walk, stoop, reach, push, pull and bend for long periods of time. Must be able to satisfactorily compete a pre-employment physical. Must be able to obtain a Food Handler's Certificate and/or complete food handler's training. Must be able to satisfactorily complete a National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI).

Performs other related duties as assigned. If interested in applying for this position you may preview the online application: https://apply.usastaffing.gov/ViewQuestionnaire/12996588

You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if the position allows for qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application. You will be evaluated on the basis of your level of competency in the following areas:

Prepares and cooks a variety of menu items including hamburgers, grilled sandwiches, eggs, quick meals, cold sandwiches and salads. Grills steaks, chops, poultry, pancakes, bacon, sausage, etc, by watching while the items are cooking, turning as required and removing when done.

Prepares and cooks fresh, frozen or canned vegetables and fruits for serving as directed. Prepares desserts, juices, and other items as directed by higher-grade cooks. Places cooked food in serving dishes, steam carts and food trucks. Washes and cleans kitchen equipment.

Maintains assigned area in a neat and orderly manner and in compliance with fire, safety, sanitation and security regulations. Maintains rotation of food inventories to prevent spoilage. Maintains proper temperature for all foods during holding, transport, reheating, and serving to assure quality control and food safety.

Covers, dates and properly stores all food items at the close of business or shift. Verifies and stores food supplies properly. May be required to assist with monthly and mid-monthly food and beverage products inventories. Provides World Class Customer Service with an emphasis on courtesy.

Assists customers and communicates positively in a friendly manner. Takes action to solve problems quickly. Alerts the higher-level supervisor, or proper point of contact for help when problems arise. Adheres to safety regulations and standards.

Promptly reports any observed workplace hazards, and any injury, occupational illness, and/or property damage resulting from workplace mishaps to the immediate supervisor. Adheres to established standards of actively supporting the principles of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other related duties as assigned.
SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE: Basic knowledge of food preparation principles and a practical understanding of the physical changes that occur during the processing and cooking of food. Ability to follow oral and written instructions, i.e., cookbooks, menus and schedules.

Ability to work safely, i.e., use knife properly to avoid cuts, be alert to open jets or escaping gas when grilling. Knowledge of food service equipment sufficient to operate and clean electrical food choppers, slicers, shredders, grinders and mixers. Ability to evaluate a variety of raw and cooked food items to ascertain their freshness.

Knowledge of principles of food spoilage, food borne illness and food safety. Ability to decide when the foods cooked are done without overcooking. Ability to season foods according to set procedures. Ability to obtain a Food Handlers Card.

RESPONSIBILITY: Receives work assignments orally and/or writing from supervisor, higher-grade cook, schedule or cook's worksheet. Normally a higher-grade cook or supervisor is available to answer questions and to ensure that work is being done properly. May work without supervision for short periods.

PHYSICAL EFFORT: Lifts and carries objects up to 45 lbs independently and objects over 45 lbs with assistance.

WORKING CONDITIONS: Exposed to warm and noisy kitchens, steam, fumes and cooking odors; danger of falling on freshly mopped floors; burns from steam or hot foods; cuts from knives; shocks from electrical machines; and extremes in temperatures.

Plan and schedule the use of workers, equipment, facilities, materials and tools on a week to week or month to month basis. Establish deadlines, priorities, and work sequences, and plan work assignments.
Review work in progress and upon completion; determine required and adjust plans, assignments, methods, and menus as necessary to accomplish the mission as effectively and efficiently as possible.
Open and/or close dining facility and 'Grab and Go' locations ensuring all security measures/requirements are adhered to. Plan, coordinate, and times work assignments to assure that food items are prepared on time and are at the proper temperature.
Prepare and cook any or all food items in bulk quantities or individual servings for regular and/or modified diets required for morning, noon, evening, late meals, and/or special feedings.
Perform the duties of a journeyman cook as required. Receive work assignments from the Executive Chef or immediate supervisor in the form of a cook’s worksheet, menus, standardized recipes, meal schedules, and special work orders.
Who May Apply: US Citizens Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social).

You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience. There is no specific length of training or experience required.

However, you must be able to demonstrate, through experience shown in your written application materials that you possess the sufficient knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the work of this position without more than normal supervision.

Minimum Qualifications (Screen Out Element): Ability to do the work of Cook Supervisor without more than normal supervision. Ability to perform common cooking tasks, food preparation techniques, and provide supervision to employees. Ability to plan and organize work assignments for other employees and explain work requirements and procedures.

In addition, plan the coordination, preparation, and cooking process to produce an entire meal. Works under supervision of a work leader or journey-level employee who reviews work for completion. - Failure to meet this Screen out Element will result in an ineligible rating.

PHYSICAL EFFORTS: Performs work requiring continual standing and walking, and frequent stooping, reaching, pushing and pulling, and bending. Frequently lifts or move objects weighing up to 50 pounds unassisted, and occasionally lifts or moves objects weighing, or over 50 pounds with the assistance of lifting devices or other workers.

WORKING CONDITIONS: The work is performed in kitchen areas, which are well lighted, but are often hot and noisy. Cooks are exposed to steam, fumes, and odors from cooking and to extreme temperature changes when entering walk-in refrigeration or freezing units.

There is danger of slipping on wet floors that have been recently mopped, or where food has been spilled. Subject to possible cuts from knives and burns from steam, hot foods, stoves, and hot grease and water.

In order to qualify for this position, resumes must provide sufficient experience and/or education, knowledge, skills, and ability to perform the duties of the position.

Applicant resumes are the key means for evaluating skills, knowledge, and abilities as they relate to this position therefore, applicants are encouraged to be clear and specific when describing experience.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBLITIES: Performs duties as such short order grill cook and/or assist the cook in the preparation of lunch or dinner meals. Performs a limited variety of tasks, such as grilling foods to order, i.e., hamburgers, pancakes, bacon, eggs, etc. Selects food items to be services and ensures their freshness.

Takes direct customer orders or ticket orders from waitresses ensuring items are cooked to order, served using authorized portion controls and temperature and turning to avoid burning. Assists/or prepares simple items such as sandwiches, soups, salads. Measures and weighs ingredients according to simple recipes or as directed.

Places cooked food on serving dishes, steam or food carts. Ensures group orders are served simultaneously. Keeps grills, stoves, refrigerators and working areas in a neat and clean manner in accordance with safety and sanitation regulations. Notifies supervisors of items needed in order to maintain stock.

May be required to assist in taking inventory. May be required to collect money, operate a cash register and prepare necessary documentation for cash fund accountability. May be required to occasionally perform other duties within the facility.
Resumes must include information which demonstrates experience and knowledge, skills, and ability (KSAs) as they relate to this position. Applicants are encouraged to be clear and specific when describing their experience level and KSAs. All non-government positions identified on your resume must include complete address and to and from dates.

Government positions must include pay plan, series, grade, to and from dates and address of the agency/organization. A qualified candidate must possess the following: Requires knowledge in preparing grilled items, salads, cold cut sandwiches and use of related appliances.

Requires knowledge of janitorial maintenance, products and ability to perform cleaning duties independently. Must have ability to follow oral and written instructions, use kitchen equipment (chopper, grinders, shredders, meal slicer) and to determine when foods are properly cooked.

You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer and part time experience. You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

As part of the application process, you must complete and submit an occupational questionnaire and your RESUME MUST SUPPORT AND VALIDATE YOUR ANSWERS or you may be removed from consideration. ONLY THE MOST HIGHLY QUALIFIED CANDIDATES WILL BE REFERRED.

IF MANAGEMENT DOES NOT WISH TO SELECT A HIGHLY QUALIFIED CANDIDATE, THEY MAY REQUEST A REFERRAL LIST INCLUDING WELL OR QUALIFIED APPLICANTS. Please follow all instructions carefully. Errors or omissions may affect your rating and/or appointment eligibility.

PLEASE READ THIS VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT IN ITS ENTIRETY TO ENSURE ALL REQUIREMENTS ARE ADDRESSED IN YOUR APPLICATION PACKAGE.

RELOCATION: NO Payment of Permanent Change of Station (PCS) is authorized, based on a determination that a PCS move is not in the Government interest KEY REQUIREMENTS/CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT Males must be registered or exempt from Selective Service. https://www.sss.gov/register/ Selectee must be determined suitable for federal employment.

Selectee may be required to successfully complete a probationary period. Selectee is required to participate in the direct deposit pay program. Social Security Card is required. Satisfactorily complete an employment verification (E-VERIFY) check.

As of May 7, 2025, The REAL ID act requires visitors to have a REAL ID or passport to access to Government Facilities. This will be a requirement for employment. A favorable background is a requirement of this position. Failure to obtain and maintain a favorable background may result in the withdrawal of the position offer or removal.

NOTE: Applicants have the ability to perform an E-Verify Self Check to confirm employment eligibility at http://www.uscis.gov/mye-verify/self-check. Für unseren Kunden suchen wir eine/n Koch/Köchin mit EFZ und entsprechender Arbeitserfahrung.
Du arbeitest gerne in der Küche, behältst auch in hektischen Momenten den Überblick und hast Freude daran, Gäste mit gutem Essen glücklich zu machen? Dann passt dieser Job perfekt zu dir. In dieser Rolle bist du verantwortlich für die Vorbereitung und Zubereitung von Speisen sowie im täglichen Küchenablauf.
Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem das Vor- und Zubereiten von Gerichten, das Einhalten von Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards sowie das Mitorganisieren der Abläufe in der Küche. Du arbeitest strukturiert, sauber und effizient und findest dich schnell in neue Küchen, Teams und Prozesse ein.

s.h: Der Arbeitsgeber hat folgende zusätzliche Aufgaben erwähnt
s.t:
Feststelle ab 1.10 100%, oder Befristet Oktober 26 bis April 27
Aufgabe
-Mitarbeit im À-la-carte-Service an Matchtagen des EVZ sowie bei internen und externen Anlässen
-Schwerpunkt Patisserie
-Führung eines eigenen Postens sowie Verantwortung für verschiedene Outlets in der OYM hall
-Mithilfe bei der Durchführung von Caterings und Anlässen in und ausserhalb der OYM hall mit bis zu 850 Gästen
-Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Küchenbetriebs und einer konstant hohen Produktqualität
-Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von Projekten im Küchenbereich
-Einhaltung und Sicherstellung der HACCP-Richtlinien

-Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Koch/Köchin EFZ
-Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung mit fundierten fachlichen Kenntnissen
-Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Funktion im Event- Catering- oder Gastronomiebereich
-Selbstständige, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie Unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln
-Belastbare, verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Teamgeist
-Flexibilität für Abend- und Wochenendeinsätze

-Attraktiver Lohn 5'300-6'000 (verhandelbar)
-aktive Mitwirkung an einer Neueröffnung
-Abwechslungsreiche Einsätze bei Heimspielen,
-Events und Grossanlässen
-13 bezahlte Feiertage
-Durchdienst sowie teils Tagesdienste
-Mitgestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
-Zahlreiche Mitarbeitervergünstigungen
-Ein lebendiges Arbeitsumfeld mit hochklassigem Sport und exklusiven Events
Arbeitszeiten sind sehr flexibel je nach Woche und Events in der jeweiligen Woche.
Grundsätzlich 5 Tage pro Woche a 42 Stunden
Es können auch Wochenendtage und Nachtarbeiten (max. bis 23 Uhr) sein und auch Arbeitszeiten, die mal 12 Stunden sind
und dafür am nächstmöglichen Tag kompensiert werden.
Keine Parkplätze vorhanden

Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Koch / Köchin EFZ oder bringst mindestens sieben Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Küche mit. Du arbeitest zuverlässig, teamorientiert und behältst auch bei hohem Tempo einen kühlen Kopf. Sauberes Arbeiten, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude am Kochen runden dein Profil ab.

HOTELIS est la seule société spécialisée dans le recrutement pour les métiers de la restauration et de l'hôtellerie pour les postes fixes et temporaires. HOTELIS est le partenaire privilégié de nombreux hôtels de catégorie supérieure, de restaurants, de services traiteurs (events, stades et centres d'exposition) et d'exploitants de restaurants de collectivité.
Pour une institution située à Bassecourt, nous recrutons plusieurs :
Cuisiniers missions temporaires (horaires continus)
Vous maîtrisez parfaitement les différentes techniques de cuisson essentielles au métier de cuisinier. En professionnel accompli, vous prenez en charge la mise en place selon le poste occupé, en veillant à ce que tout soit prêt pour le service.

Votre rigueur dans l'exécution des tâches est exemplaire, et vous suivez scrupuleusement les directives du chef de cuisine. Votre grande flexibilité vous permet de vous adapter aisément aux exigences du service, tout en respectant avec précision les normes d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire en vigueur (HACCP).

Vous êtes ainsi un véritable atout pour toute brigade.
Vous bénéficiez d'une solide expérience de plusieurs années en tant que cuisinier ou chef de partie, que ce soit dans un restaurant traditionnel, une brasserie ou une cuisine collective. Vous êtes titulaire d'un CFC de cuisinier.

Dynamique, rigoureux et passionné par la cuisine, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et souhaitez rejoindre une brigade de cuisiniers motivée. Vous savez gérer efficacement le stress et êtes à la recherche de nouvelles opportunités professionnelles. De plus, vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français.
Ce poste vous intéresse ?
Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature, qui sera traitée en toute discrétion.

08/06/2026: This position is being re-announced to solicit additional candidates. Applicants who previously applied to this announcement need not re-apply unless submitting updated information and/or missing forms.

Prepares foods according to diet orders, menus and standardized recipes for residential Youth Regional Treatment Center clients, YRTC personnel and guest meals. Prepares food for cooking such as washing, peeling, chopping and grinding for cooking. Roasts, bakes, fries, boils and stews meats, fish and poultry.

Monitors the preparation and evaluates the condition of the food being prepared at frequent intervals to ensure optimum flavor, quality and appearance. Observes high personal hygiene standards and all required safe food handling practices. Performs assigned cleaning duties as scheduled.

Maintains food storages areas for cleanliness and proper storage and food labeling.
To qualify for this position, your resume must state sufficient experience and/or education, to perform the duties of the specific position for which you are applying.

Le Centre hospitalier universitaire vaudois (CHUV) est l’un des cinq hôpitaux universitaires suisses, et figure parmi les meilleurs établissements hospitaliers au monde du magazine Newsweek. Grâce à sa collaboration avec la Faculté de biologie et de médecine de l’Université de Lausanne et l’EPFL, il joue un rôle de référence dans les domaines des soins, de la recherche et de la formation.
Le Département de la logistique hospitalière (LOH) a pour mission de s'assurer que les unités de soins, d'enseignement et de recherche puissent pleinement se concentrer sur leur cœur de métier, en leur offrant et en développant des prestations d'exploitation logistiques efficientes (désinfection et entretien, transferts de patients, stérilisation, restauration, transports de marchandises, gestion des stocks,…).
La restauration du Service hôtelier (HOT) regroupe plusieurs cuisines de grande importance qui produisent chaque année plus de 2,2 millions de repas destinés aux patient\-e\-s, aux collaborateur\-trice\-s et aux visiteurs. Cette activité est assurée par plus de 280 professionnel\-le\-s engagé\-e\-s dans une démarche de qualité, de sécurité alimentaire et de service.

Vous réalisez les préparations culinaires en respectant les prescriptions diététiques et les besoins spécifiques des patients
Vous produisez et distribuez des mets de qualité, en respectant les règles du métier et celles propres à la cuisine hospitalière
Vous appliquez les recettes élaborées en équipe et veillez à la qualité de leur mise en valeur
Vous partagez les informations utiles au bon déroulement des tâches et assurez la continuité du service
Vous respectez strictement les directives d’hygiène et de sécurité en vigueur dans l’institution
Vous participez à la formation des apprenti\-e\-s en cuisine
Vous êtes amené\-e à travailler sur différents sites (travail dans des locaux borgnes selon l'emplacement.)

Vous êtes OBLIGATOIREMENT titulaire d’un CFC de cuisinier\-ère en diététique ou d’un titre en diététique jugé équivalent, par exemple, l'attestation ou le certificat de cuisinier\-ère en diététique, qui s'obtient via une formation continue sanctionnée par un examen professionnel
Vous justifiez d’au moins 2 années d’expérience dans le domaine de la cuisine ; une expérience en milieu hospitalier ou en restauration collective constitue un atout
Vous avez suivi ou êtes disposé\-e à suivre le cours de formateur\-trice en entreprise (un atout)
Vous maîtrisez la langue française tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit
Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d’autonomie et d’organisation
Vous disposez d’une bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques usuels
Vous êtes disposé\-e à travailler le soir, les week\-ends et les jours fériés et à effectuer un service de piquet.

Devenir une collaboratrice ou un collaborateur du Centre hospitalier universitaire vaudois, c'est l'assurance de bénéficier:
De prestations sociales de premier ordre, d'un congé paternité de 20 jours et d'un congé maternité de 4 mois (avec possibilité d’un mois supplémentaire de congé d’allaitement)
D'une progression salariale régulière et adaptée aux responsabilités
D’un 13ème salaire et de 25 jours de vacances par année
D'un droit à trois jours de formation minimum par année, avec l’accès à une offre variée au sein du Centre des Formations du CHUV et des centres de formation partenaires de l'Etat de Vaud
D’avantages sociaux, culturels et économiques offerts aux membres de l’association H\-Oxygène
D’avantages proposés dans le cadre du plan de mobilité (rabais sur les abonnements des transports publics, promotion des véhicules «Mobility» et rabais sur l’achat de vélos électriques
De restaurants d'entreprise dans chacun des bâtiments hospitaliers avec des tarifs préférentiels.

## ##
Nous sommes des hôtes passionnés - Avec ta recette préférée, tu peux choyer nos invités. Chez nous, tu découvriras les différentes stations ainsi que le métier en cuisine et pourras laisser libre cours à ta passion.
Commence ton apprentissage avec nous le 1er août, car nous t'offrons la bonne dose de variété et sommes la recette du succès adaptée à ton avenir.
\#hitthebutton - nous sommes impatients de te rencontrer et de créer ensemble de délicieuses spécialités - télécharge tes documents de candidature.
## **Ce que tu feras** ##
* Avec l'équipe de cuisine et ton coach, tu feras vibrer notre restaurant et enthousiasmeras nos invités
* Tu prépares des menus savoureux à base de fruits, légumes, viande, poisson et épices
* Tu veilles au bien-être physique de tes invités
* Ensemble, nous créons la gastronomie d'aujourd'hui et de demain et développons de nouvelles tendances culinaires
* Tu assumes des responsabilités et mets créativement tes plats en scène dans l'assiette
* Tu vérifies la livraison des marchandises, contrôles la qualité des aliments et les stockes correctement
## **Ce que tu apportes** ##
* Joie de travailler avec les aliments et de cuisiner
* Un sens développé de l'odorat et du goût
* Le calme dans les moments de stress est naturel pour toi et tu affrontes le stress avec un sourire
* Créativité et ingéniosité, ainsi qu'un fort esprit d'équipe
* Bonne capacité de compréhension et mains agiles
## **Ce qui te caractérise** ##
* Résistance et persévérance
* Capacité de motivation
* Esprit d'équipe
* Compétence au changement et volonté d'apprendre
* Capacité de planification et d'organisation
* Engagement et volonté de performance
## **Ton lieu de travail** ##
Au restaurant Martinsberg et au bistrot Bowl'n'Rowl à Baden, notre équipe d'hôtes composée de douze collaborateurs chouchoute quotidiennement environ 450 invités. L'offre attractive comprend deux menus changeant quotidiennement, un buffet à choix libre et un buffet de salades.

Au bistrot Bowl'n'Rowl, nous cuisinons chaque jour un plat dans un bol et un burrito. Dans les deux restaurants, la pause collation avec des produits de boulangerie, des sandwichs frais et des offres à emporter maison est un plaisir. Grâce à l'offre de catering interne, il est possible de commander des snacks et des boissons pour des réunions.

Dans l'aula et la salle de jardin, des événements plus importants tels que banquets, fêtes et apéritifs peuvent également être organisés. Des actions d'entreprise régulières ainsi que des événements spéciaux sont organisés.
Tu travailles du lundi au vendredi, selon le planning. Pour les événements en soirée et les week-ends, tu es disponible de manière flexible.
## **Ce que nous t'offrons - entre autres** ##
**Événements :** Semaine d'introduction, Chiefs for a Week, cours spécialisés SV, fête de fin d'apprentissage
**Finances :** 1ère année d'apprentissage CHF 1'020, 2ème année : CHF 1'300, 3ème année : CHF 1'550, 13ème salaire, participation financière aux frais de matériel scolaire
**Jours de travail :** semaine de 42 heures (principalement du lundi au vendredi dans un restaurant pour employés SV)
**Vacances :** 6 semaines
**Restauration :** repas frais, sains et gratuits pour les employés
**Autres avantages :** Consulte notre site web
## **J'attends ta candidature avec impatience** ##
Monika, Business Partner HR Young Talents
## SV (Suisse) SA ##
**SV (Suisse) SA**
SV est un groupe leader dans la gestion de la gastronomie et de l'hôtellerie, basé à Dübendorf près de Zurich. Le groupe est actif dans plusieurs domaines d'activité : restaurants pour entreprises et écoles, hôtels avec marques propres ainsi qu'avec d'autres marques renommées en tant que franchisé, restaurants publics avec concepts innovants ainsi que service de livraison gastronomique et catering. SV emploie environ 5'500 collaborateurs, dont 3'300 en Suisse.
SV remonte à l'organisation à but non lucratif fondée en 1914 « Schweizer Verband Soldatenwohl ». Else Züblin-Spiller a créé des foyers pour soldats dans tout le pays et y servait une alimentation équilibrée et abordable. Les valeurs idéelles de la fondatrice sont aujourd'hui poursuivies par la Fondation SV. Cette fondation à but non lucratif est l'actionnaire majoritaire de SV et utilise ses moyens pour des projets dans le domaine de la nutrition saine et pour le bien commun.

Das **SAH Zürich** ist eine Non- Profit-Organisation mit Impact: Wir bringen Menschen weiter - mit Bildungsangeboten, Jobprogrammen und Beratungen in Zürich und Umgebung.
Das **Angebot MenSAH** ist ein dreimonatiges Qualifizierungsprogramm für stellensuchende Gastronomie-Mitarbeitende. Während der Arbeit in der Mensa der Rudolf-Steiner-Schule in Wetzikon werden sie fachspezifisch begleitet. Ziele sind die Erhaltung der Arbeitsfähigkeit, die Erweiterung der beruflichen Qualifikation und die Optimierung der Bewerbungsstrategie für einen nachhaltigen Wiedereintritt in den Arbeitsmarkt.
Für unser **Angebot MenSAH** in Wetzikon suchen wir dich per 1. November 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung als:
**Fachleiter\*in/ agogische\*r Koch/Köchin 80 % (4 ganze Tage).**
**Deine Aufgaben**
* Du arbeitest agogisch mit unseren Teilnehmenden im Küchenalltag
* Du stellst einen reibungslosen Produktionsablauf sicher und verantwortest die Zubereitung sowie die Ausgabe von täglich rund 140 Mahlzeiten.
